nodes.description: Oracle.pair: IUniswapV2Pair instance used for all price/reserve external calls
Oracle.pairAddress: public address of the tracked Uniswap pair
Oracle.token0: cached address of pair token0 used for token direction checks
Oracle.token1: cached address of pair token1 used for token direction checks
Oracle._cookAddress: private address used to decide which cumulative price is returned
Oracle.price0CumulativeLast: last stored cumulative price (token0/token1)
Oracle.price1CumulativeLast: last stored cumulative price (token1/token0)
Oracle.blockTimestampLast: last update timestamp used for timeElapsed computation
Oracle.price0Average: fixed-window average price (uq112x112) for token0
Oracle.price1Average: fixed-window average price (uq112x112) for token1
Oracle.latestPrice0: decoded 18-decimal price for token0
Oracle.latestPrice1: decoded 18-decimal price for token1
Oracle.PERIOD: minimum seconds between successful updates (constant, set to 1 second)
Ownable._owner: privileged account controlling ownership functions
Oracle constructor: validates addresses, initializes pair/tokens/cumulative values and reserves
Oracle.update: permissionless price refresh, enforces PERIOD and rewrites averages/cumulatives
Oracle.consult: view function converting amountIn to amountOut using stored averages
UniswapV2OracleLibrary.currentCumulativePrices: external calls to pair plus counterfactual price accumulation
UniswapV2OracleLibrary.currentBlockTimestamp: block.timestamp truncated to uint32
Context._msgSender: returns msg.sender (GSN meta-transaction hook)
Ownable.owner: returns current owner address
Ownable.renounceOwnership: onlyOwner, sets owner to zero address
Ownable.transferOwnership: onlyOwner, transfers ownership to newOwner
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership checks
block.timestamp: miner-influenceable time source driving the oracle window
External calls into IUniswapV2Pair (price0CumulativeLast, price1CumulativeLast, getReserves, token0, token1)
Unchecked/overflow-desired arithmetic: blockTimestamp - blockTimestampLast and priceCumulative - priceCumulativeLast / timeElapsed
FixedPoint.mul overflow-checked multiplication used to decode averages into 1e18 prices
constructor parameter _pairAddress
constructor parameter cookAddress
consult parameter token: caller-supplied token address
consult parameter amountIn: caller-supplied input amount
currentCumulativePrices parameter pair: target pair address
transferOwnership parameter newOwner
update local: uint32 timeElapsed = blockTimestamp - blockTimestampLast
update local: uint32 blockTimestamp returned by currentCumulativePrices
update local: uint256 price0Cumulative
update local: uint256 price1Cumulative
constructor local: uint112 reserve0 from getReserves
constructor local: uint112 reserve1 from getReserves
update return local: latestP price returned to caller
